name: city-cart-mobile
description: Android and iOS apps for THE CITY CART (Capacitor). The screens are the shared website served by the same backend.

scripts.sync:android:emulator: MOBILE_ENV=android-emulator npm run build && MOBILE_ENV=android-emulator cap sync android
scripts.sync:ios:simulator: MOBILE_ENV=ios-simulator npm run build && MOBILE_ENV=ios-simulator cap sync ios
scripts.sync:device: MOBILE_ENV=device npm run build && MOBILE_ENV=device cap sync
scripts.sync:production: MOBILE_ENV=production npm run build && MOBILE_ENV=production cap sync
scripts.android:emulator: npm run sync:android:emulator && MOBILE_ENV=android-emulator cap run android
scripts.ios:simulator: npm run sync:ios:simulator && MOBILE_ENV=ios-simulator cap run ios
scripts.android:device: npm run sync:device && MOBILE_ENV=device cap run android
scripts.ios:device: npm run sync:device && MOBILE_ENV=device cap run ios
scripts.apk:debug: npm run sync:device && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:debug:emulator: npm run sync:android:emulator && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
